seasonal_check.extra_time: typically adds 20 to 80 seconds (small area, red and NIR only, up to 3 scenes per window); it is off by default
seasonal_check.what_it_does: flags vegetation-loss polygons whose NDVI also fell in the same windows of earlier years (likely harvest or a seasonal cycle); polygons are never removed

warnings: A window of 122 days spans several seasons. The composite uses the clearest scenes, which can come from different times of the year in the two periods; prefer one to three months of the same season.
next_step: Call detect_change with the same arguments.
